text:
maria: Quick ping — the link-scan flagged 8 KB pages under runtime/kb with dead shortlinks. Can folks claim ownership so we can batch fixes this sprint? I can take two but need volunteers for the rest. Scan results: https://internal.tools/scan/6375/results :link:
maria: Also small ops ask — can someone run a quick frontmatter replace for the old shortlink prefix `/s/` -> `/short/`? Example frontmatter we want to standardize:
```yaml
---
owner: @team-member
shortlink: /s/old-ref
---
```
should become:
```yaml
---
owner: @team-member
shortlink: /short/old-ref
---
```
maria: Would prefer PRs that include a one-line changelog and add yourself as owner in the frontmatter so we don't lose track. Thanks!

dan: I can take runtime/kb/kv-cache-404 and runtime/kb/dead-anchor. Will open PRs later today. :+1:

alex: I can pick runtime/kb/anchors and runtime/kb/diagrams. Also saw a runbook with a missing image alt — I'll include that in my PRs. :eyes:

triage-bot: automated: 8 issues flagged, priority=low, avg_age=21d. See scan dashboard for details.

rookie-editor: Quick sed I used for a similar sweep (mac/linux friendly):
```bash
git grep -l "shortlink: /s/" | xargs -r sed -i '' -e "s|/s/|/short/|g"
```
Worked for a small batch for me, but please run in a branch and CI.

maria: Perfect, thanks everyone. If someone can spare a quick review for my PRs (and Dan's) ping me here — I'll tag reviewers in the PRs. I'll coordinate merges so we avoid hitting the same files. :pray:

alex: I'll review you + Dan today. Tag me in the PRs and mention if CI is flaky so I can re-run. Also ping @eng-docs in the PR body for visibility on owner changes.

maria: Sweet. Final note — please include the original scan link in the PR description so we can close each issue in the tracker when merged.
